resolved_conflicts.explanation: A May 1934 item planned a 30-foot tower; the register and firelookout.com date the tower to 1936; the history page lists panorama photos taken in August 1935; and a 1937 USFS survey disk was set in the base of a tower leg. The sources do not line up closely. The story gives 1936, the year both the register and firelookout.com use.

notes_for_editor: No source describes what stands on the summit now or whether the public can reach it. The 2008 site photo is in the register gallery, but its caption does not say whether any structure is visible; an editor could check the image itself. The names in the staffing list come only from firelookout.com. Edward Dmytryk is named only as the sources give him: the Wikipedia article on the film director of that name does not mention a lookout, and nothing in these sources ties the two together, so the story does not link them.
